name: Qoqand

queries.query: Qoqand Uzbekistan official cadastral parcel map public viewer API cadastral map
queries.result: Found the official Uzbekistan National Geoinformation Portal (open.ngis.uz), Digital Government description of its cadastral purpose, and a catalog record documenting its ArcGIS REST service host. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

queries.query: Qo'qon kadastr xaritasi rasmiy geoportal O'zbekiston
queries.result: Found the official Kadastr Agency National Geoinformation Portal and Uzbek-language government description. The portal advertises cadastral-number and land-use information, but no anonymous parcel geometry response was obtained.
